results.title: Spain World Cup Roster, Projected Starting Lineup
highlights:
# Spain World Cup Roster, Projected Starting Lineup
[...]
The 2026 FIFA World Cup is right around the corner, and Spain enter as the long-time betting favorite to win the tournament. It’s a talented squad that claimed the 2024 European Championship and features some of the best young players in the world.
[...]
many options to pick from
[...]
de la Fuente will set up
[...]
squad for the opening Group H match against Cape Verde on June 15.
[...]
Below, we’ll discuss the Spain World Cup squad and the potential Spain starting lineup, as well as the team's strengths and weaknesses.
[...]
## Projected Starting XI for the Spain National Team at the 2026 World Cup
[...]
To say that de la Fuente is spoiled for choice is an understatement. The Spanish squad has world-class talent at every position and has one of the best midfield units in all of football.
[...]
Spain’s roster is composed of three GKs, four FBs, four CBs, seven CMs, and eight FWs — three of whom are STs. The biggest shock is the lack of any players from Real Madrid, something that has never happened in 92 years of Spain competing at the World Cup.
[...]
La Roja may set up in a 4-3-3 system, much as they have for years. The focal point will continue to be a midfield anchored by Rodri and controlled by the masterful Pedri, who won the UEFA Euro 2020 Young Player of the Tournament award at just 18 years of age.
[...]
The potential absence of Lamine Yamal, who's confirmed to have returned to training after a hamstring injury, wouldn’t even be a detriment in the group stage. However, as soon as he returns, he'll immediately slot into the right wing.
[...]
Ferran Torres has had a solid campaign this season for Barcelona, but Mikel Oyarzabal of Real Sociedad could end up leading the line after he scored the winning goal in the 2024 Euro final against England. He has 18 goal contributions in his last 15 appearances for the national team.
[...]
## Projected Spain 4-3-3
[...]
- Goalkeeper: Unai Simon
- Defense: Marcos Llorente, Aymeric Laporte, Pau Cubarsi, Marc Cucurella
- Midfield: Rodri, Pedri, Fabian Ruiz
- Forwards: Lamine Yamal, Mikel Oyarzabal, Nico Williams
[...]
Spain is favored to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup behind a loaded squad full of bright and exciting young talent. After claiming the 2024 European Championship, they’ll look to overcome the pressure of expectations and lift their second World Cup in five tournaments.
